aboutUs.title: ABOUT US

aboutUs.text_2: We have more than twelve uninterrupted years in China, fully advising and representing top Argentine companies, achieving recognition of the hard work of our team by the Argentine Foreign Ministry, granting the prestigious MARCA PAÍS certificate to one of our quadrilingual partners established in China with the licensing of Argentine in the world.

about_card_two.title: Confidence and Success in your operations with the Chinese Market without barriers or risks
about_card_two.text_1: Sino Argentina Group is a company dedicated to adding value to the global foreign trade production chain, emphasizing the nations of Argentina and China, we have a strategic presence in Buenos Aires and Guangzhou, (Canton).
about_card_two.text_2: We have more than twelve uninterrupted years in China, fully advising and representing top Argentine companies, achieving recognition of the hard work of our team by the Argentine Foreign Ministry, granting the prestigious MARCA PAÍS certificate to one of our quadrilingual partners established in China with the licensing of Argentine in the world.
about_card_two.text_3: In Argentina we have extensive knowledge in international trade with partners with more than 25 years of experience in foreign trade specialized in business development, market opening and international logistics.

about_card.text_1: Achieving the recognition of one of our partners as a first-level advisor to the President of the Alliance for Productive Integration (APIP) made up of confederations, associations, chambers and educational institutions.
about_card.text_2: Sino Argentina Group is responsible for finding professional suppliers, offering different supplier alternatives according to your requirements and negotiating the best prices and purchasing conditions. Once the purchase contract is closed, we take care of all the logistics so that your products arrive in Argentina correctly.
about_card.text_3: If you are planning to open the Chinese market for your exports, we will carry out market research, identifying potential clients; we will facilitate the sale negotiation and verify the veracity and seriousness of the Chinese importer. Once the sale is closed, we will also take care of all the logistics from any location in Argentina to the final destination in China.

HorizontalCard.title: MISSION
text: Simplify the complex, achieving a pleasant experience in foreign trade by bringing ideas to reality by accompanying the processes required to successfully fulfill the needs of our clients.

InvertCard.title: VISION
text: Sino Argentina Group aspires to be the definitive strategic commercial bridge between Argentina and China for our clients.

Looking at the different companies as cooperators to strengthen and add value to the production chain, achieving greater efficiency in quality and value through our outstanding comprehensive commercial service and deep cultural understanding of both nations. Achieving beneficial and long-term relationships with our clients.

whyUs.title: WHY US
whyUs.text_card_1: At Sino Argentina Group, we have strategically located offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. This duality allows us to provide a comprehensive service that covers every detail of import and export procedures, ensuring a fluid and effective connection between both markets.
whyUs.text_card_2: Our team of bilingual professionals based in China have an advanced command of Chinese and Spanish, ensuring clear communication without cultural or language barriers. This positions us as a reliable partner for your international business.
whyUs.text_card_3: We understand the challenges of finding reliable suppliers in China and securing serious buyers for your exports. We specialize in preventing fraud and scams, providing customized solutions that ensure the success of your business operations.
whyUs.text_card_4: From finding suppliers and customers to complete logistics, we take care of every step of the process. We offer alternatives tailored to your needs, negotiate the best conditions and supervise every detail so that your products arrive at their destination without problems.

services_cardTwo.title: Confidence and Success in your operations with the Chinese Market without barriers or risks
services_cardTwo.text_1: We know the complexity of finding the right supplier in China to be able to import without falling into fraud or scams; as well as the uncertainty of knowing if the buyer of your products in China is serious and will comply with the purchase conditions for your exports to China.
services_cardTwo.text_2: These difficulties, which arise both in importing from China and in the sale of Argentine products there, require our management to successfully carry out the purchase/sale negotiations and procedures.
services_cardTwo.text_3: Our experience and knowledge of the Asian market allow us to accompany you at every step, from the selection of the ideal supplier or client to the final logistics, ensuring that your business operations are carried out effectively, safely and successfully.

allServices.title: WHAT DO WE HAVE TO OFFER YOU?
allServices.card_title_1: Analysis, Negotiation and Purchasing with Suppliers in China
allServices.card_text_1: Sino Argentina Group is your strategic ally in the search and selection of reliable suppliers in China, adjusting to your budget. We negotiate the best commercial conditions on your behalf, guaranteeing product quality and punctual delivery.
allServices.card_text_2: We offer a comprehensive logistics service, covering everything from cargo consolidation and customs clearance at origin to final delivery at destination. Our market knowledge and extensive network of agents allow us to optimize routes and reduce transportation costs, ensuring the integrity of your goods at all times.
allServices.card_text_3: Do you want to expand your business to the Chinese market? Sino Argentina Group accompanies you every step of the way. We carry out customized market studies, identify potential clients and distributors, and provide you with the necessary advice to develop a successful business strategy..
allServices.card_text_4: We organize business trips tailored to your needs, facilitating the scheduling of meetings with suppliers, clients and potential business partners. Our team will accompany you throughout your stay, providing assistance with translation, logistics and visa management.

ANCPC.text_1: Se realiza una reunión en donde el cliente proporciona detalles sobre el producto a buscar (especificaciones técnicas, cantidad, calidad, etc.). Luego se definen los requisitos de certificación y cumplimiento normativo. Finalmente, se establece un presupuesto estimado.
ANCPC.text_2: Se realiza una búsqueda exhaustiva en bases de datos especializadas y plataformas de comercio electrónico. Se contactan y evalúan múltiples proveedores en función de su reputación, capacidad de producción y precios. Se solicita información detallada sobre los productos, muestras y catálogos.
ANCPC.text_3: Si es necesario, se organizan visitas a las fábricas para verificar las condiciones de producción y la calidad de los productos.
ANCPC.text_4: Se negocian los precios, los plazos de entrega, las condiciones de pago, las garantías y los términos del contrato. Se redacta y revisa el contrato en conjunto con el cliente.
ANCPC.text_5: Se realiza un seguimiento constante del proceso de producción, asegurando que se cumplan los estándares de calidad y los plazos acordados.
ANCPC.text_6: Se contrata a una empresa de inspección independiente para verificar la calidad de los productos antes del envío.
ANCPC.text_7: Se coordinan los detalles del envío, incluyendo el embalaje, el transporte y el despacho aduanero en origen. Luego, se efectúa el envío internacional efectuando el seguimiento de toda la Logística Internacional.

LI.text_1: Se coordinan los detalles de la recepción de la mercancía en la fábrica del proveedor.
LI.text_2: Si es necesario, se consolida la carga de varios proveedores en un solo contenedor.
LI.text_3: Se gestiona el despacho aduanero en China, incluyendo la preparación de la documentación necesaria y el pago de los impuestos correspondientes.
LI.text_4: Se selecciona la modalidad de transporte más adecuada en función de los plazos y el presupuesto.
LI.text_5: Se realiza un seguimiento constante del envío a través de plataformas de seguimiento online.
LI.text_6: Se gestiona el despacho aduanero en Argentina, incluyendo la presentación de la documentación necesaria y el pago de los impuestos correspondientes.
LI.text_7: Se coordina la entrega de la mercancía en el destino final, ya sea en el almacén del cliente o en cualquier otro lugar indicado.

OpenMarket.text_1: Se realiza un estudio detallado del mercado chino para identificar las oportunidades de negocio y los principales competidores. Posteriormente se definen los canales de distribución más adecuados.
OpenMarket.text_2: Se identifican y contactan potenciales distribuidores o representantes en China y se evalúan sus capacidades y redes de contactos.
OpenMarket.text_3: Se elabora un plan de marketing y ventas adaptado al mercado chino también, se definen los objetivos comerciales a corto y largo plazo.
OpenMarket.text_4: Se organiza la participación en ferias comerciales relevantes para dar a conocer los productos y establecer contactos.
OpenMarket.text_5: Se desarrollan materiales de marketing en chino y se implementan campañas publicitarias en los canales adecuados.
OpenMarket.text_6: Se gestionan las ventas y se brinda soporte a los clientes chinos.
